text:
marie: Quick design review request — PR up for the vectors preview row toolbar + export modal. Focus areas: keyboard focus order on the row toolbar, screen reader labels, and CSV export column order. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/vector-preview-export (see frames 'row-toolbar' + 'export-modal')

jon: thanks — skimmed. my immediate thought: export column order should match the table visual order. Users expect the first column in CSV to be the visible first column. currently CSV starts with 'vector' which is weird.

sam: agree with jon. also keyboard: when focus lands on a row, the toolbar buttons are after the row actions in tab order. I'd expect toolbar to be reachable with a single tab after the row, not buried.

alex: quick a11y note — row buttons need explicit aria-labels. VoiceOver will read "button" but not the purpose if we just use icons. e.g. use aria-label like: 
<button aria-label=\"Open row actions for item 23\">⋯</button>

kelly: small copy tweak for export modal: title "Export selection" -> "Export rows (CSV)" — clearer for screen readers and keyboard users. Also suggest adding aria-describedby that references the CSV column order when exporting large sets.

aria-bot: Automated accessibility checklist run: missing aria-labels on 3/5 row toolbar buttons; export modal lacks aria-live region to confirm completion; CSV header ordering mismatch with table order. Recommendations: add aria-labels, ensure tab index order equals visual order, add aria-live=\"polite\" on export status.

marie: thanks — adding examples below. Can someone take the aria-label + tab order changes? I'll update copy.

alex: I can do the aria-labels + unit test for the toolbar. Will add something like: 
```html
<button aria-label=\"Open row actions for {{row.id}}\" data-testid=\"row-actions-{{row.id}}\">⋯</button>
```
and update focus handling to use roving tabindex pattern.

sam: i'll adjust tab order and add keyboard docs. Also verify that pressing Enter on a focused row opens the primary action, per platform pattern.

aria-bot: Suggested CSV header (consistent with table left->right):
``n_id,text,metadata:source,metadata:created_at,vector_norm,relevance_score
```
Note: use stable keys (n_id) not transient db ids for reproducible exports.

marie: perfect. Alex/sam — ping me when PR is ready. I'll run a quick VoiceOver pass on mac. small ask: please wire export modal to announce "Export started" and "Export complete" via aria-live.

jon: also add a small sample in docs showing how to import back and map 'metadata:source' -> source field. helps support and power users.

alex: will include the aria-live and tests. PR later today: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4567

marie: awesome — thanks all :sparkles:
